known.reason: The workspace panel close button is 25x25 CSS pixels, but a neighbouring control leaves only 15px of unobscured width, so 2.5.8 fails on spacing rather than on size. Clearing it is a panel-header layout change, not a size bump.
The same panel-header spacing defect; forced colors is emulated at the media-query level and leaves the geometry unchanged.
The same panel-header spacing defect; reduced motion changes only animation and leaves the geometry unchanged.

The empty source-monitor text renders --kw-editor-muted at 11px, measured 3.45:1 against the 4.5:1 minimum. That token carries muted text throughout the editor, so darkening it is a design decision rather than a local override.
The same muted-token contrast defect: forced colors is emulated at the media-query level here and does not substitute the operating system's own palette, so the measured ratio is unchanged.
The same muted-token contrast defect; reduced motion changes only animation, so the measured ratio is unchanged.
At 200% zoom the empty source-monitor panel body becomes scrollable while holding no focusable content, so a keyboard user cannot scroll it.
